text:
Maya (PM): Quick heads-up: planning to ship xenon v2.4.1 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need RN blurb, pin schedule, canary cadence, and ops standby. Quiet window 08:45-09:15 PT. Owners please ack.

Sanjay (EngProd): Ack. I'll run staging canary 06:00 PT and prod canary at 09:00 PT with 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Health checks: xenon_canary_errors, request_latency_p95. Rollback if p95 > baseline *1.2 OR error rate >0.5% for 5m.

Lena (Docs): I can draft the internal RN + short ops bullets. Will post draft by 18:30 PT today.

Tom (Oncall): On standby for rollout. Add me to deploy-bot rollcall. No infra changes? any config flips?

Sanjay (EngProd): Single flag toggle: enable_xenon_v241=true. Setting autoscale min_replicas=2 for canary window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 3171599999 by @Sanjay — Canary plan: 10% @09:00 -> 50% @09:10 -> 100% @09:20. Healthchecks: xenon_canary_errors, request_latency_p95. Commands:
```
# start canary
deployctl start --image xenon:v2.4.1 --canary 10,50,100 --flag enable_xenon_v241=true
# rollback
deployctl rollback --image xenon:v2.3 --reason "perf/regression"
```

Maya (PM): Lena - include two bullets: batching improvements (~12% token cost reduction) and minor tokenizer tweak for rare unicode. No API change. Link to playbook.

Lena (Docs): Draft (internal): "Rolling out xenon v2.4.1 at 09:00 PT. Expected ~12% lower token cost from batching. Minor tokenizer tweak fixes rare unicode edgecases; no API change. Ops: follow canary cadence and monitor xenon_canary_errors and p95 latency. Rollback: flip enable_xenon_v241=false and redeploy xenon:v2.3. Full playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/xenon-v241"

Tom (Oncall): Request pins: post internal RN in #eng at T+5m after 100% cutover, pin in #product at T+15m. I'll watch dashboards and trigger rollback if thresholds met. :eyes: 

Maya (PM): Embargo public comms until 09:30 PT. Internal RN only in #eng at T+5m, #product pinned at T+15m. Lena publish internal RN at 09:05 PT (short) and attach detailed playbook.

Sanjay (EngProd): Adding temporary metric xenon_canary_errors and dashboard. If perf regression >5% vs baseline, we'll pause and extend canary. Rollback owner: Sanjay — will revert flag + redeploy xenon:v2.3 and notify channel.

Nora (Support): Preparing support note in case customers ask. Will hold until final go.

Maya (PM): Final checklist:
- Lena: RN draft + post (09:05 PT)
- Sanjay: canary schedule + metric + autoscale change
- Tom: oncall + pin posting
- Deploy-bot: execute canary cadence
If all good I'll mark ready. :thumbsup:

Sanjay (EngProd): Infra ready. I'll post canary start log when it begins.

Lena (Docs): Posting RN at 09:05 PT and attaching rollback excerpt.

deploy-bot: @Tom added to rollcall for rollout 3171599999.

Tom (Oncall): Watching dashboards. GLHF :rocket:
